{{Infobox football league season | competition = [[Côte d'Ivoire Ligue 1]] | image = | season= 2019–20 | dates = 17 August 2019 – 8 March 2020 | winners= [[Racing Club Abidjan]] | relegated= None | continentalcup1= [[2020–21 CAF Champions League|CAF Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers= [[Racing Club Abidjan]] | continentalcup2 = [[2020–21 CAF Confederation Cup|CAF Confederation Cup]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers= [[FC San Pédro]] | matches= 140 | total goals= 311 | highest scoring= [[Williamsville Athletic Club|Williamsville]] 2–7 [[AS Tanda]] (22 February 2020) | biggest home win= [[ASEC Mimosas]] 4–0 [[AS Tanda]] (4 December 2019) | biggest away win= [[Williamsville Athletic Club|Williamsville]] 2–7 [[AS Tanda]] (22 February 2020) [[Issia Wazi FC|Issia Wazi]] 1–6 [[Academie de Foot Amadou Diallo|AFAD]] (9 February 2020) | longest wins= [[Racing Club Abidjan]], [[FC San-Pédro]] & [[AS Tanda]] (4 matches) | longest unbeaten= [[USC Bassam]] (9 matches) | longest winless= [[Williamsville Athletic Club|Williamsville]] (12 matches) | longest losses= [[Issia Wazi FC|Issia Wazi]] (6 matches) | prevseason= [[2018–19 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2018–19]] | nextseason= [[2020–21 Côte d'Ivoire Ligue 1|2020–21]] | updated= 2 July 2020 }} The '''2019–20 Côte d'Ivoire Ligue 1''' is the 61st season of the [[Côte d'Ivoire Ligue 1]], the top-tier league of the [[Ivorian football league system]] since its establishment in 1960.The season started on 17 August 2019 but was suspended on 8 March 2020 due to the effects of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Ivory Coast|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite news |title=Ivory Coast suspends league season |url=https://www.kingfut.com/2020/03/18/ivory-coast-halt-sporting-events-coronavirus/ |work=[[Kingfut.com]] |accessdate=18 March 2020}} On 26 June 2020 however, the [[Ivorian Football Federation|FIF]] announced that the season has been cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Ivory Coast|coronavirus pandemic]]. [[Racing Club Abidjan]] were crowned champions and will represent the country at the [[2020–21 CAF Champions League]] while there would be no relegation with the two teams promoting from the [[Ligue 2 (Cote d'Ivoire)|Ligue 2]] expanding the league to 16 starting from the next season.{{cite news |title=Cote d'Ivoire cancels season, names Racing Club Abidjan champions |url=https://futaa.com/ng/article/209517/ivory-coast-cancels-league-names-continental-representatives |work=[[Futaa.com]] |date=26 June 2020 |archive-date=4 July 2020 |access-date=3 July 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200704125441/https://futaa.com/ng/article/209517/ivory-coast-cancels-league-names-continental-representatives |url-status=dead }} They further stated that the [[Coupe de Côte d'Ivoire|2020 Coupe de Côte d'Ivoire]] has been cancelled, with second-place finishers, [[FC San Pédro]] representing the country at the [[2020–21 CAF Confederation Cup]].[https://www.koaci.com/article/2020/06/26/cote-divoire/sport/cote-divoire-la-ligue-1-arretee-le-racing-dabidjan-declare-champion-de-la-saison-2019-2020_142650.html Koaci.com] {{in lang|fr}} [[SO de l'Armée]] were the defending champions, winning the championship in the [[2018–19 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2018-2019]] season. ==Teams== Fourteen teams contested the league, twelve teams from the [[2018–19 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|previous season]] and two promoted teams from the [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|2018–19 Ligue Two]]; [[Stars Olympic Club Abobo|SOL FC]] and [[Issia Wazi FC|Issia Wazi]] who replaced [[LYS Sassandra]] and [[Moossou FC]] as they were relegated from the [[2018–19 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|previous season]].
